name: @activepieces/piece-mind-studio
description: Run MindStudio workflows and get AI results.

run_workflow.name: run_workflow
run_workflow.description: Run a workflow from your MindStudio app and start a thread.

workflow.description: Workflow name to run (without the .flow extension).

variables.description: Key-value variables passed to the app.

callbackUrl.description: URL to receive the execution result asynchronously.

includeBillingCost.description: Return the billing cost in the response.

aiMetadata.description: Executes a MindStudio app workflow to get an AI result, identified by App ID (and optionally a specific workflow name within the app). Pass input as key-value variables; optionally supply a callback URL to receive the result asynchronously instead of inline. Use when an agent needs to invoke a prebuilt MindStudio AI app. Not idempotent: each call starts a new thread/execution and may incur billing cost.
